title: Chip pinout library
description: Hand-curated, deterministic pinout database for arcade-era parts. Not RAG, not generated. Every entry must come from a primary datasheet and cite it.

kind.description: ic = DIP/QFP chip with synthesized lib_symbol from `pins`. discrete = resistor/cap/switch/connector that maps to a KiCad stock symbol via kicad_symbol.

package.description: For ICs: e.g. DIP-14, DIP-20, DIP-40 — drives the auto footprint mapping. Discretes typically declare kicad_footprint directly instead.

kicad_symbol.description: Stock KiCad symbol id, e.g. 'Device:R', 'Switch:SW_Push'. Required when kind=discrete; ignored for ICs (which get a synthesized symbol).

kicad_footprint.description: Override for the auto footprint mapping. Useful for non-standard widths or for discretes whose footprint isn't derivable from `package`.

value_required.description: If true, instances of this part must carry a `value` (resistance, capacitance, frequency). The KiCad export uses this as the symbol's Value property; the BOM aggregates by it.

polarized.description: True for parts where pin order matters (electrolytic caps, diodes, LEDs). The identifier must record which lead is the + / cathode.

pin_count.description: For discretes, how many pins the stock symbol has. Used by the explorer auto-fill for connectors and switches.

datasheet.description: Citation: vendor, year, page. Free text — this is provenance not a URL.

name.description: Functional name. Tilde prefix for active-low (~OE, ~WE).

group.description: Optional grouping for buses, e.g. 'A' for the A side of a transceiver
